question_vi: API Key authentication và multi-tenant trong NestJS?
question_en: API Key authentication and multi-tenant patterns in NestJS?
answer_html_vi:
API Key Auth Guard: extract key từ header, validate trong DB hoặc cache:

typescript
@Injectable()
export class ApiKeyGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private apiKeysService: ApiKeysService) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const apiKey = request.headers['x-api-key'];
    if (!apiKey) throw new UnauthorizedException('API key required');

    const keyRecord = await this.apiKeysService.validateKey(apiKey);
    if (!keyRecord) throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid API key');

    request.tenant = keyRecord.tenant;  // Attach tenant context
    return true;
  }
}

Multi-tenant pattern: mỗi request mang tenant context, services filter data theo tenant:

typescript
// REQUEST scope — instance riêng mỗi request
@Injectable({ scope: Scope.REQUEST })
export class TenantContext {
  constructor(@Inject(REQUEST) private req: Request) {}

  get tenantId(): string {
    return (this.req as any).tenant?.id;
  }
}

Các strategies: separate DB per tenant, shared DB với tenant_id column, schema per tenant.

Cân bằng giữa isolation và cost.
answer_html_en:
API key auth guard: pull the key from the header, validate it against the DB or cache:

typescript
@Injectable()
export class ApiKeyGuard implements CanActivate {
  constructor(private apiKeysService: ApiKeysService) {}

  async canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): Promise<boolean> {
    const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
    const apiKey = request.headers['x-api-key'];
    if (!apiKey) throw new UnauthorizedException('API key required');

    const keyRecord = await this.apiKeysService.validateKey(apiKey);
    if (!keyRecord) throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid API key');

    request.tenant = keyRecord.tenant;  // attach tenant context
    return true;
  }
}

Multi-tenant pattern: each request carries a tenant context and services filter data by tenant:

typescript
// REQUEST scope — a separate instance per request
@Injectable({ scope: Scope.REQUEST })
export class TenantContext {
  constructor(@Inject(REQUEST) private req: Request) {}

  get tenantId(): string {
    return (this.req as any).tenant?.id;
  }
}

Strategies: a separate DB per tenant, a shared DB with a tenant_id column, or a schema per tenant — a trade-off between isolation and cost.
